summary: The exact candidate fixes the reproduced attention-TP metadata padding mismatch and passes its regression plus independent CPU and gfx950 adversarial checks. It is a verified partial source fix, not proof of the full eight-H20 GLM-5.3 disaggregated deployment.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction of the candidate contract: three padding cases failed (9 vs 12, 6 vs 8, and 9 vs 12 rows); the no-padding identity case passed.
Candidate regression: 4 passed, covering issue-class SUM_LEN padding, another DP rank, MAX_LEN, and no-padding identity.
100 independent cases across padding modes, DP ranks, TP widths, boundary token counts, rank-2 tensors, prefix preservation, and zero-fill.

tests.command: timeout 60s env PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-b40f9ea8ec3a/venv/bin/python - (gfx950 tensor probe; candidate commit)
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI350X, a device tensor was padded from 9 to 12 rows with its prefix preserved and three zero rows appended.
Changed Python source and regression compile successfully.
The exact candidate base-to-tip diff has no whitespace errors; the prior raw-log counterexample is corrected.

gpu_execution.evidence: A production pad_dsa_cache_seqlens tensor operation ran on one AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 and passed. This is not the original CUDA/H20 kernel path.

native_rebuild_reason: No native source changed. The candidate modifies one Python module, adds a Python test, and updates report artifacts.
remaining_counterexamples: The original eight-H20 GLM-5.3-W4AFP8 disaggregated decode path was not executable in the one-gfx950 environment.
CUDA FlashMLA and its fwd_kvcache_mla num_splits validation were not executed; the available system is ROCm, not CUDA.
Mooncake/InfiniBand transfer, TP=8/DP=2 multi-rank synchronization, model-specific GLM behavior, and EAGLE warmup remain unverified.
remaining_limitations: Only the shared Python metadata-sizing contract and a ROCm device tensor operation were exercised.
No GLM-5.3-W4AFP8 weights or eight NVIDIA H20 GPUs were available.
A passing narrow regression cannot establish end-to-end semantic or distributed correctness.
